'''Chapter 499''' is titled "Sabaody Park".

==Cover Page==
[[CP9's Independent Report]], Vol. 9: "Showboating For Medical Fees: The Giraffe Slide".

Doing their part to fund [[Rob Lucci|Lucci]]'s operation, [[Fukurou]] manages [[Kaku]] (in Beast Form) as a slide for [[St. Poplar]]'s children.

==Short Summary==
The [[Straw Hat Pirates]] arrive at [[Sabaody Park]] where [[Camie]] gets kidnapped by a team of kidnappers.

==Long Summary==
The chapter opens with [[Shakuyaku]] saying goodbye to the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]], who are off to find a [[coating]] mechanic. The scene shifts to [[Bounty Hunter|bounty hunters]], [[Minoruba]] and [[Kairiken]], who are discussing about the [[Camie|mermaid]] who was seen with [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]. The head of the [[Hound Pets|kidnapping team]], [[Peterman]], promises ten percent of the [[Belly|money]] they would get for Camie to the bounty hunters who brought him that information. Meanwhile, Luffy and the others arrive at [[Sabaody Park]] and start to enjoy the amusements there.

The scene shifts to Groove 24 with the arrival of a [[World Noble|Celestial Dragon]], namely Saint [[Charlos]]. He kills a badly injured [[Humans|human being]] and decides to make an [[Marriage|engaged]] [[Doctor|nurse]] ([[Marie]]) his sixth wife by shooting her [[Judy|fiancée]]. [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]], wondering whether he is lost and not knowing about the situation, walks towards the Celestial Dragon, upsetting him. The Noble tries to shoot Zoro who dodges it before the bullet can connect. Zoro tries attacking Charlos, but [[Jewelry Bonney]] tackles him away and fakes Zoro's death using her [[Toshi Toshi no Mi|Devil Fruit powers]] and some [[Foods/Beverages#Other Varieties 2|tomato juice]], knowing that attacking a World Noble would result in an [[Admiral]] having to come to the island. After being informed of the situation by Bonney, Zoro takes the injured man to a hospital, to the surprise of some of the other [[Super Rookie|Supernovas]] who are nearby, with [[Scratchmen Apoo]] remarking that Zoro let off a very high killing intent just moments earlier.

At the [[Thousand Sunny]], [[Sanji]], [[Usopp]] and [[Franky]] receive a call on a [[Den Den Mushi]] telling them that Camie has been kidnapped. Sanji replies that he will inform the [[Rosy Life Riders|Flying Fish Riders]].

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*The [[World Noble|Celestial Dragon]] [[Charlos|Saint Charlos]] is introduced.
*[[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] almost attacks Charlos for shooting at him, but [[Jewelry Bonney]] intervenes and stops him.
*Bonney demonstrates the [[Toshi Toshi no Mi|ability to change her age]] from that of a grown adult to a little girl.
*[[Camie]] gets kidnapped by the slave trader [[Peterman]].
*Knowing that their previous work in kidnapping and [[Slavery|slave trading]] are essential in knowing on where to look for Camie, [[Sanji]] decides to call in the [[Rosy Life Riders|Flying Fish Riders]].
